McpServerDefinition.description: Zenthera Patient Support Program (demo, fictional data): tools for patient services coordinators. Tools: enroll a patient, refill history, patient 360 profile.

tools.descriptionOverride: Enrolls ONE patient in the Zenthera Patient Support Program (demo, fictional patients). Use when asked to enroll or register a patient. Required: firstName, lastName, birthdate (YYYY-MM-DD), therapy (exactly Zenthera 50 mg or Zenthera 100 mg), insuranceType (Commercial, Medicare, Medicaid or Uninsured), consentGiven (true only if the user says the patient gave consent, else false). Recommended: mobilePhone. Optional: prescriberName. Ask for missing values; never guess birthdate or consent. Finds the patient by name + full birthdate, creates a new patient if none, refuses ambiguous matches and duplicate open enrollments. Returns resultCode (SUCCESS, VALIDATION_ERROR, NO_CONSENT, AMBIGUOUS_MATCH, DUPLICATE_ENROLLMENT, ERROR), resultMessage (show to user), enrollmentNumber (ENR-...), patientId, enrollmentId. Write operation: call once, never retry automatically.

Read-only. Shows a Zenthera Patient Support Program patient's refill (dispense) history and whether the next refill is ON_TRACK, DUE, LATE or NO_DELIVERED_REFILL. Use for questions about refills, shipments, deliveries, next refill date or how many days late a refill is. Inputs: patientName (full name as recorded) or enrollmentNumber (ENR-...); optional asOfDate (YYYY-MM-DD, default today). Only Delivered shipments count; due date = last Delivered date + days supply; days overdue = days past that date. Returns resultCode (SUCCESS, NOT_FOUND, AMBIGUOUS_MATCH, NO_ENROLLMENT, INVALID_INPUT, ERROR), resultMessage (show to user), refillStatus, nextRefillDueDate, daysOverdue, dispenseHistory. Reports recorded shipments only; never claim the patient took the medication and give no medical advice.
